review_candidates.title: IT Manager
review_candidates.description_excerpt: The IT Manager will implement security protocols, maintain data backup and recovery processes, and troubleshoot technical issues. Qualifications Strong skills in IT infrastructure management, including network administration, server management, and systems monitoring. Proficiency in hardware and software installation, configuration, maintenance, and troubleshooting.
eligibility_evidence: FIG partners with founders, corporates, and institutions across Egypt, the GCC, and international markets, offering a regional and global perspective.
This part-time, on-site role in Qesm El Maadi includes managing networks, hardware, and software, monitoring system performance, and coordinating IT support for team members.
